about_the_game:
Overview

Surreal virtual trading game where you use quick reactions to shoot buy and sell buttons to buy and sell made up stocks. Buy and watch the value of your investment go up and down in value and sell when it reaches the value you want.

How it works

You hold down the left mouse button to charge the shot with money. When you shoot the amount of money charged will be loaded into the bullet. This is your investment in the made up stock you will buy when you hit the buy button with your bullet. Shoot the sell button with your bullet to cash in any virtual gains/losses you have made with that made up stock.

Variation

Different chart tickers are more volatile so move more rapidly up or down which also affects the price and how much you earn from what is put in.

Shoot power ups that appear as the game goes on that can help with your trade.

Challenge

You have to time it right to buy or sell. As if the chart goes too far to the right of screen or crashes at bottom of the screen it is game over.

High Scores

The game saves your high score at game over.

Controls

One Button - Left Mouse Button

content_descriptors.notes: Contains fantasy virtual trading, gambling elements.
